title: Part (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. For the first part, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, start by drawing an arc from the point (0.0, 0.0047) to (0.0014, 0.0014) and end at (0.0047, 0.0). Continue by drawing a line from (0.0047, 0.0) to (0.0328, 0.0). Next, draw an arc from (0.0328, 0.0) to (0.0361, 0.0014) and end at (0.0375, 0.0047). Draw a line from (0.0375, 0.0047) to (0.0375, 0.0328). Follow this with an arc from (0.0375, 0.0328) to (0.0361, 0.0361) and end at (0.0328, 0.0375). Draw a line from (0.0328, 0.0375) to (0.0047, 0.0375). Then, draw an arc from (0.0047, 0.0375) to (0.0014, 0.0361) and end at (0.0, 0.0328). Finally, draw a line from (0.0, 0.0328) to (0.0, 0.0047). For the second loop, draw an arc from (0.0019, 0.0047) to (0.0027, 0.0027) and end at (0.0047, 0.0019). Draw a line from (0.0047, 0.0019) to (0.0328, 0.0019). Next, draw an arc from (0.0328, 0.0019) to (0.0348, 0.0027) and end at (0.0356, 0.0047). Draw a line from (0.0356, 0.0047) to (0.0356, 0.0328). Follow this with an arc from (0.0356, 0.0328) to (0.0348, 0.0348) and end at (0.0328, 0.0356). Draw a line from (0.0328, 0.0356) to (0.0047, 0.0356). Then, draw an arc from (0.0047, 0.0356) to (0.0027, 0.0348) and end at (0.0019, 0.0328). Finally, draw a line from (0.0019, 0.0328) to (0.0019, 0.0047). Scale the sketch by a factor of 0.0375. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions with no rotation or translation. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction and 0.0 units in the opposite direction to create a new solid body. The dimensions are 0.0375 in length, 0.0375 in width, and 0.75 in height.

For the second part, create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to 0.0, 0.0, -90.0 and a translation vector of 0.0159, 0.0, 0.6862. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw a circle centered at (0.0028, 0.0028) with a radius of 0.0028. On the second face, in the first loop, draw a circle centered at (0.0028, 0.0403) with a radius of 0.0028. Scale the sketch by a factor of 0.0431. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions with no rotation and translate it by 0.0159 units along the x-axis, 0.0 units along the y-axis, and 0.6862 units along the z-axis. Extrude the sketch 0.0 units along the normal direction and 0.0234 units in the opposite direction to remove material from the existing body. The dimensions are 0.005625 in length, 0.043125 in width, and 0.0234375 in height.

reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Part 1: Create the cylindrical object with a rectangular section at the top
part_1 = cq.Workplane("XY") \
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0047) \
    .threePointArc((0.0014, 0.0014), (0.0047, 0.0)) \
    .lineTo(0.0328, 0.0) \
    .threePointArc((0.0361, 0.0014), (0.0375, 0.0047)) \
    .lineTo(0.0375, 0.0328) \
    .threePointArc((0.0361, 0.0361), (0.0328, 0.0375)) \
    .lineTo(0.0047, 0.0375) \
    .threePointArc((0.0014, 0.0361), (0.0, 0.0328)) \
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0047) \
    .close() \
    .extrude(0.75)

# Part 2: Create the cylindrical cutout
part_2 = cq.Workplane("XY") \
    .moveTo(0.0028, 0.0028) \
    .circle(0.0028) \
    .moveTo(0.0028, 0.0403) \
    .circle(0.0028) \
    .extrude(-0.0234) \
    .translate((0.0159, 0.0, 0.6862)) \
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), -90)

# Combine the parts
r = part_1.cut(part_2)

import cadquery as cq
import math

w = 0.0375
h = 0.7500
c = 0.0053
m = c * (1 - math.sqrt(0.5))

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, c)
    .threePointArc((m, m), (c, 0))
    .lineTo(w - c, 0)
    .threePointArc((w - m, m), (w, c))
    .lineTo(w, w - c)
    .threePointArc((w - m, w - m), (w - c, w))
    .lineTo(c, w)
    .threePointArc((m, w - m), (0, w - c))
    .lineTo(0, c)
    .close()
    .extrude(h)
)
